<!-- markdownlint-disable -->

## Overview

Keep V2 drafters from reading past their rotary cache when the target is served with a longer context (#57941). Where it's safe, the drafter's `max_position_embeddings` is raised to the target's `max_model_len`. Otherwise, on Model Runner V2, the engine's `max_model_len` is lowered to the drafter's, with a warning.

This incorporates the generalization from #57964 by @twu3202 (co-author on the second commit).

## Claims

- The `max_position_embeddings` override that already exists for EAGLE (#48894) now applies to every method except `draft_model`, including DFlash, DSpark and MTP. It's applied only when all of the drafter's RoPE types use that value just to size the cache: `default`, `linear`, `llama3`, `ntk`, `proportional`.
- On V2, any other drafter with a `max_model_len` below the target's lowers the engine's `max_model_len`, with a warning. That covers independent `draft_model` drafters and drafters whose RoPE type can't be extended (yarn, dynamic, longrope, ...). Today such a drafter crashes the engine with an illegal memory access on the first request past its limit.
- V1 is unchanged. It skips speculation past the drafter's limit (`_input_fits_in_drafter`), so the target's `max_model_len` stays as it is.

## Validation

- `tests/config/test_speculative_draft_limits_max_model_len.py` (new, CPU):
  - `draft_model` (2048) with an 8192 target: `max_model_len` is 2048 on V2 (this fails without the change) and stays 8192 on V1.
  - EAGLE-3 drafter (2048) with an 8192 Llama-3.1 target on V2: the cache is raised and `max_model_len` stays 8192. With the RoPE type treated as not extendable, `max_model_len` is lowered to 2048.
- `tests/config/test_speculative_draft_max_position_embeddings.py` (from #57964): which RoPE types allow raising the cache, and DFlash/DSpark drafters inheriting a 65536 target context.
- TODO: CI test results, and an end-to-end repro (`Qwen/Qwen3-4B` at 65536 with `z-lab/Qwen3-4B-DFlash-b16`, and with a `draft_model` drafter, sending a request longer than the drafter's limit).

## Details

Root cause: `SpeculativeConfig` sets `draft_model_config.max_model_len = min(draft, target)`. On V1, the model runner turns that into a check that skips speculation for longer batches. The V2 speculators never read the drafter's `max_model_len`: they clamp positions and sequence lengths against the target's, so they keep drafting past the drafter's rotary cache.

- **Raise when possible:** drafters other than `draft_model` take the target's positions. For cache-only RoPE types, `max_position_embeddings` only sizes `cos_sin_cache`, so raising it doesn't change the rotary frequencies. Other RoPE types either size the cache from `original_max_position_embeddings` or derive frequencies from `max_position_embeddings`, so raising it there would be wrong.
- **Otherwise cap:** making V2 skip speculation per batch would be less restrictive, but it adds branching to every V2 speculator. Capping `max_model_len` at config time is simple and safe. The tradeoff is that such deployments can't serve sequences longer than the drafter's limit even without speculation, and the warning says so. The check lives in `VllmConfig` because only it knows which model runner is in use. `SpeculativeConfig.draft_shares_target_positions()` holds the same condition as the override, so the two stay in sync.
- An explicit speculative `max_model_len` below the target's also caps the target, unless the drafter's cache is raised; V2 ignores that setting in that case.

Ran the end-to-end repro from the TODO in the description on one RTX 6000 Ada (sm_89). The PR arm is 179288fdc, and the base arm is the same tree with `vllm/config/speculative.py` and `vllm/config/vllm.py` from e879223b5. Both run on e879223b5's precompiled wheel, so only those two files differ.

Target `Qwen/Qwen3-4B` at `--max-model-len 65536`, with `--hf-overrides '{"max_position_embeddings": 65536, "rope_parameters": {"rope_type": "yarn", "factor": 2.0, "original_max_position_embeddings": 32768, "rope_theta": 1000000}}'`. Both drafters have `max_position_embeddings` 40960. Each run sends a short greedy request, then a 45,000-token prompt with `max_tokens=32`, then the short request again.

| drafter | runner | base | this PR |
|---|---|---|---|
| `z-lab/Qwen3-4B-DFlash-b16`, 15 tokens | V2 | 500, EngineCore dies with an illegal memory access | logs the 40960 → 65536 override; 200, engine stays up |
| `Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B` as `draft_model`, 4 tokens | V2 | 500, EngineCore dies on a device-side assert (`index out of bounds ... < 40960` in the compiled rotary gather) | warns and lowers `max_model_len` to 40960; the long prompt gets a 400, engine stays up |
| same `draft_model` | V1 | not run | `max_model_len` stays 65536; 200 |

With this PR the engine stays up in all three runs and the short request returns the same text before and after the long one. The 32 tokens from the DFlash run match the V1 `draft_model` run.
✅ No failed, timed-out, or expired jobs need retrying in [Buildkite CI #96827](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/96827).

✅ Triggered [Buildkite CI #96908](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/96908) for commit `e9a6c4434ed2`.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Tests that the V2 model runner limits max_model_len to the draft's (#57941).
+
+The V2 speculators draft at every length the target accepts, so a draft model
+whose max_model_len is smaller than the target's (and whose rotary cache can't
+be raised to match) must lower the target's max_model_len. The V1 model runner
+instead skips speculation for longer batches, so it keeps the target's
+max_model_len.
+"""
+
+import pytest
+
+from vllm.config import ModelConfig, ParallelConfig, SpeculativeConfig, VllmConfig
+
+# All repos are public; only config/tokenizer-config files are fetched.
+AR_MODEL = "JackFram/llama-68m"  # max_position_embeddings=2048
+EAGLE3_DRAFT = "yuhuili/EAGLE3-LLaMA3.1-Instruct-8B"  # max_position_embeddings=2048
+LLAMA3_TARGET = "unsloth/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct"  # max_position_embeddings=131072
+
+
+@pytest.mark.cpu_test
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("use_v2_model_runner", [True, False])
+def test_draft_model_limits_max_model_len(
+    use_v2_model_runner: bool, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
+):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER", str(int(use_v2_model_runner)))
+    model_config = ModelConfig(AR_MODEL, hf_overrides={"max_position_embeddings": 8192})
+    speculative_config = SpeculativeConfig(
+        target_model_config=model_config,
+        target_parallel_config=ParallelConfig(),
+        model=AR_MODEL,
+        method="draft_model",
+        num_speculative_tokens=3,
+    )
+    vllm_config = VllmConfig(
+        model_config=model_config, speculative_config=speculative_config
+    )
+    assert vllm_config.use_v2_model_runner == use_v2_model_runner
+    draft_model_config = speculative_config.draft_model_config
+    assert draft_model_config.max_model_len == 2048
+    expected = 2048 if use_v2_model_runner else 8192
+    assert vllm_config.model_config.max_model_len == expected
+
+
+@pytest.mark.cpu_test
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("resizable", [True, False])
+def test_eagle_draft_limits_max_model_len_unless_resized(
+    resizable: bool, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
+):
+    """An EAGLE draft's max_position_embeddings is raised to the target's
+    max_model_len when its RoPE type allows it; otherwise the draft limits
+    max_model_len."""
+    monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER", "1")
+    if not resizable:
+        monkeypatch.setattr(
+            "vllm.config.speculative._CACHE_ONLY_ROPE_TYPES", frozenset()
+        )
+    model_config = ModelConfig(LLAMA3_TARGET, max_model_len=8192)
+    speculative_config = SpeculativeConfig(
+        target_model_config=model_config,
+        target_parallel_config=ParallelConfig(),
+        model=EAGLE3_DRAFT,
+        method="eagle3",
+        num_speculative_tokens=3,
+    )
+    vllm_config = VllmConfig(
+        model_config=model_config, speculative_config=speculative_config
+    )
+    assert vllm_config.use_v2_model_runner
+    draft_hf_config = speculative_config.draft_model_config.hf_config
+    assert draft_hf_config.max_position_embeddings == (8192 if resizable else 2048)
+    assert vllm_config.model_config.max_model_len == (8192 if resizable else 2048)

✅ Triggered [Buildkite CI #96792](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/96792) for commit `79126dd993ab`.

ℹ️ This PR is 3 commits behind upstream `main`. Merged upstream `main` into this branch as `79126dd993ab` before starting CI. Pull the branch before pushing more changes.

✅ Triggered [Buildkite CI #96827](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/96827) for commit `55333fba4e43`, running 2 failed step(s) from [Buildkite CI #96792](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/96792).

Ran the end-to-end repro from the TODO in the description on one RTX 6000 Ada (sm_89). The PR arm is 179288fdc, and the base arm is the same tree with `vllm/config/speculative.py` and `vllm/config/vllm.py` from e879223b5. Both run on e879223b5's precompiled wheel, so only those two files differ.

Target `Qwen/Qwen3-4B` at `--max-model-len 65536`, with `--hf-overrides '{"max_position_embeddings": 65536, "rope_parameters": {"rope_type": "yarn", "factor": 2.0, "original_max_position_embeddings": 32768, "rope_theta": 1000000}}'`. Both drafters have `max_position_embeddings` 40960. Each run sends a short greedy request, then a 45,000-token prompt with `max_tokens=32`, then the short request again.

| drafter | runner | base | this PR |
|---|---|---|---|
| `z-lab/Qwen3-4B-DFlash-b16`, 15 tokens | V2 | 500, EngineCore dies with an illegal memory access | logs the 40960 → 65536 override; 200, engine stays up |
| `Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B` as `draft_model`, 4 tokens | V2 | 500, EngineCore dies on a device-side assert (`index out of bounds ... < 40960` in the compiled rotary gather) | warns and lowers `max_model_len` to 40960; the long prompt gets a 400, engine stays up |
| same `draft_model` | V1 | not run | `max_model_len` stays 65536; 200 |

With this PR the engine stays up in all three runs and the short request returns the same text before and after the long one. The 32 tokens from the DFlash run match the V1 `draft_model` run.
✅ No failed, timed-out, or expired jobs need retrying in [Buildkite CI #96827](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/96827).

✅ Triggered [Buildkite CI #96908](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/96908) for commit `e9a6c4434ed2`.
